headline: Australia Approves Law Requiring Internet Platforms to Remove Harmful Content
summary: Australia has passed legislation requiring internet companies to proactively remove harmful content and functions. Penalties can reach 5% of global revenue.
why: Australian regulation on online platforms can impose large fines on global technology companies operating in the country.
original_headline: Australia aprueba ley que obliga a las plataformas de Internet a eliminar los contenidos nocivos
